headerDisplay: Rinnai boiler with the WF-100W Wi-Fi controller. Your router must redirect the controller's cloud traffic (TCP 9105) to this Homebridge — see the README.
footerDisplay: Start with **Read-only** on, check the log shows the boiler state, then turn it off to allow control.

port.title: Local port
port.description: The controller talks to TCP 9105. Change only if your router rewrites the port.

mac.title: Controller MAC address
mac.description: 12 hex digits. Leave empty to accept any controller; its MAC is printed in the log.

readOnly.title: Read-only
readOnly.description: Only show the boiler state, never send commands.

powerSwitches.title: Separate power switches
powerSwitches.description: Thermostats only offer Heat, and on/off moves to extra switches "<name> Power". Stops Siri from turning the boiler off on "turn off the AC".

cloudProxy.title: Forward to the Rinnai cloud
cloudProxy.description: Keeps the My Rinnai app working. If the cloud is down, the plugin answers the controller itself.

cloudHost.title: Cloud IP address
cloudHost.description: Where your controller connects to. EU: 37.206.147.54. Korea: the IP of wifiboilers1.rinnai.co.kr. Use an IP, not a hostname.
